title: SLO feedback loop roadmap: adaptive error budget allocations and postmortem-linked initiatives
creator: Maya R. Thompson
description: Design and ship an initiative-tracking pattern that closes the loop between SLI measurement, error budget consumption, incident postmortems, and product roadmap prioritization. The goal is to ensure that when SLOs degrade we automatically surface remediation work, shift short-term allocations of error budget per-product, and track remediation progress as part of quarterly OKRs.
acceptance_criteria: A cross-team incident-to-initiative flow exists: incident -> postmortem artifact -> tracked remediation initiative in Linear
Error budget consumption is visible per-product and per-route with daily alerts when burn rate exceeds threshold
Playbook for adaptive error-budget allocation published and linked to Console routing rules
Dashboard shows initiative status, remaining error budget, and predicted breakeven if current trend continues
Canary rollout policy integrates with initiative state to auto-fallback if remediation fails
milestones: 2025-02-18: Wireframes for Console initiative view (In Review)
2025-02-25: Backend schema and API for linking postmortems to Linear issues (Planned)
2025-03-04: Pilot adaptive allocation on two product routes (Planned)
decisions: Use 'burn-rate windows' of 1h/6h/24h to trigger different levels of response rather than single threshold
Map high-burn incidents to an automatic P1 initiative when predicted error budget exhaustion < 72 hours
Keep allocation adjustments advisory for non-enterprise customers; enterprise tenants can enable automated re-routing/fallbacks
Store links to postmortem artifacts in Linear issue description with a standardized metadata header for SLI context
risks: Over-automation could cause cascading rollbacks if SLI noise isn't smoothed properly
Mis-attribution of error budget to wrong product-route causing incorrect prioritization
Dashboard complexity leading to low adoption among SRE/product owners
updates: 2025-02-12 - Maya: Drafted initial playbook and shared with SREs. Feedback request to include 6h burn window.
2025-02-14 - Carlos: Confirmed metrics availability for route-level burn rates; flagged need for smoothing heuristic.
2025-02-16 - Jordan: Wireframes for 'Initiatives' view uploaded, focusing on timeline and SLI snapshot card.
2025-02-18 - Priya: Backend design doc ready; will expose link mapping API and event webhooks for postmortems. Scheduled sync for 2025-02-20.
qa_plan: Run a pilot with two non-critical product routes. Validate alerting, initiative creation, and linkage to postmortem artifacts. Inject synthetic SLI degradation to assert UI flow and rollback actions. Track false positive rate below 10% before wider rollout.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Internal alpha for SRE and one product team (2 weeks)
Phase 1: Beta with 3 additional teams and opt-in automation (4 weeks)
Phase 2: Default advisory mode for all customers (2 weeks)
Phase 3: Enterprise auto-allocation enablement behind feature flag (coordinated with sales)
metrics: Primary SLOs: route-level availability and p95 latency
Operational metrics: error budget remaining hours, burn rate (1h/6h/24h)
Adoption metrics: percent of postmortems auto-linked, percent of incidents that spawn a remediation initiative
Outcome metrics: time-to-remediation, reduction in reoccurrence rate within 30d
notes: Design trade-offs: heavy smoothing reduces sensitivity but improves signal-to-noise for automation
Follow-up: investigate ML-based anomaly detector for burn rate when pilot shows high FP rate
Customer asks: CS suggested a CSV export of initiative history for compliance reviews
